item.title: The Presidency breaks its silence on a viral video claiming a chef poisoned President Bola Tinubu.
item.description: The Presidency has dismissed a viral video alleging that a chef working at the Presidential Villa was arrested for attempting to poison President Bola Tinubu.The video, which circulated widely online, claimed that a special police squad was deployed to the Villa and that security around the presidential residence had been tightened. It further alleged that the supposed arrest followed credible threats to the President’s safety and that security officials had launched a coordinated investigation.
